tall.note: Burned full vertical and shorts: the host's tall caption defaults (font, size, outline, shadow, ASS colours and highlight, line limits, cue lengths, cue pause), its overlap tolerance and its QC cue-onset tolerance; bands in the order placement tries them.

wide.note: Sidecar-only arc, draft and long cut: the host's sidecar limits and cue pause, its overlap tolerance and its QC cue-onset tolerance.

safe_tall.note: The host's one tall safe zone, in pixels from each frame edge; rendering reads it too.

frame.note: The host's tall frame in pixels.

aligner.note: The host's forced aligner model; the adapter reports the version actually loaded.
